title: Create your first workflow reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for create your first workflow should include: name:, on:, push:, jobs:, runs-on:, steps:, run:.
answer.example:
name: Welcome
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  welcome:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Print a welcome message
        run: echo "Replace this message"
answer.verification: On a push to `main` or a pull request targeting `main`, the `hello` job prints the greeting and ends successfully.
